lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters are arranged in roughly horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, with a notable triad of spots forming a triangle above the pectoral fin insertion point.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with the horizontal rows of blobs to create a coordinate-like grid across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, defined by a sharp intensity transition from high luminance on the dorsal surface to a darker shadow gradient immediately below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low to moderate density of high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily along the posterior half and base of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of a distinct red-pigmented circular mark near the ventral-posterior edge of the gill slits; minor irregular indentations visible on the trailing edge of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: High-frequency distribution of smaller, lower-intensity spots on the cranial region compared to the larger maculate patterning of the mid-lateral flank.
